title: MusicLuv — end-to-end workflow
subtitle: Three learner journeys — learn a lesson, record and get graded, then mentor, plans and growth — showing every screen, service, AI model, outside API, data store, guardrail and eval, as built in the code today.

meta.v: Web app (React/Vite), Node server, Python audio engine. Phone = mobile browser; native Capacitor apps are not set up yet.
From docs/product-vision.md, docs/platform-roadmap.md and the Phase 0 audit plan — drawn as Not integrated / Planned, never as live.

boxes.title: Opens MusicLuv
boxes.body: Welcome → mic check (echo cancel / noise suppress / auto-gain **off**) → picks one of **8** instruments

boxes.title: Boot and restore
boxes.body: Restores user, progress, current instrument + lesson from browser storage · `GET /api/v1/monetization/status` (launch promo)

boxes.title: Sign in
boxes.body: `POST /auth/v1/token`, `/signup`, `/otp`, `/authorize` (Google/Apple) · dev stub when `VITE_SUPABASE_URL` unset

boxes.title: localStorage
boxes.body: User, progress, XP, plan, launch status, current lesson · per device, no cloud sync

boxes.title: Scope flags
boxes.body: `VITE_FEATURES` hides community, creator, proctored, live lessons, compositions, teacher, 14 generated instruments

boxes.title: Concept → Teach → Demo → Dissect
boxes.body: First 4 of the 9 lesson phases: goal, written lesson, demo clips at 50 / 75 / 100 %, control close-ups

boxes.title: Catalogs and demo audio
boxes.body: Lessons + **745** exercises bundled from `shared/catalogs` · `GET /api/v1/reference-audio/:lessonId[/:refId]`

boxes.title: Render reference
boxes.body: `POST /render` → deterministic synthesized WAV, cached 1 year

boxes.title: Recorded reference audio
boxes.body: Educator-recorded demos (vision §7). Today every demo is synthesized sine harmonics

boxes.title: Content quality gate
boxes.body: No automated lesson lint or educator review yet; 406 lessons are generator scaffolding

boxes.title: Virtual try and guided play
boxes.body: Taps piano / guitar / violin / drums / sitar; piano range follows the lesson (e.g. C3–G4)

boxes.title: Count hits
boxes.body: Exact note, or same note name if the instrument can't play it · drums: any distinct pads · Tone.js playback

boxes.title: Instrument samples
boxes.body: `GET nbrosowsky.github.io/tonejs-instruments/…` (piano, guitar, violin) · Google Fonts

boxes.title: Self-hosted samples
boxes.body: Licensed, cached for offline (roadmap Phase 2)

boxes.title: Touch safety
boxes.body: Pointer events + `touch-none`: one tap = one note; hit counted before samples load

boxes.title: Records a take
boxes.body: Mic live meter → **one-bar count-in** → plays → Done / auto-stop · optional *Offline mode*

boxes.title: Capture
boxes.body: Keeps audio only from 150 ms before the downbeat → WAV 22.05 kHz (device rate fallback) · live pitch meter on the same audio clock

boxes.title: IndexedDB offline queue
boxes.body: `musicluv/offlineAttempts`: WAV + grading request, status pending → graded

boxes.title: Only the take is graded
boxes.body: Warm-up notes and waiting are discarded; live meter is display-only

boxes.title: Sees grader status
boxes.body: ● grader live · ⚠ grader offline (takes saved) · ○ demo mode (simulated)

boxes.title: Send for grading
boxes.body: `POST {VITE_AUDIO_ENGINE_URL}/grade` multipart: WAV + target (scaled to take tempo) + rubric + `mode` notes/onsets · 30 s timeout

boxes.title: CREPE pitch model
boxes.body: `PITCH_BACKEND=crepe` (TensorFlow). Default is pYIN — classic signal processing, **no AI model**. No LLM in grading

boxes.title: Grade
boxes.body: pYIN pitch (band from targets) → split notes at re-attacks → align, fit start offset + tempo → score **pitch (cents) · rhythm · consistency**

boxes.title: Server grade history
boxes.body: Client calls the engine directly; `POST /api/v1/grade` proxy that records attempts is unused

boxes.title: Engine limits
boxes.body: 20 MB / 180 s (413) · WAV/FLAC/OGG only (415) · unknown note 422 · tone & dynamics **not graded**

boxes.title: Grading tests + real-audio gate
boxes.body: 74 engine tests incl. edge cases · teacher-agreement ≥ 90 % gate, **skips until recordings exist**

boxes.title: Result, overlay, drill, quiz
boxes.body: Score + issues (wrong note, cents, early/late, missed, tempo) · take vs target overlay · micro-drill · mastery quiz

boxes.title: Apply the grade
boxes.body: Lesson `passCriteria` on top of rubric pass → XP, hearts, lessons completed. Simulated grades: **no** progress

boxes.title: localStorage progress
boxes.body: Per device; lost if storage is cleared

boxes.title: Mastery quiz
boxes.body: 217 exams in catalog · MCQ + listening live · notation, tap-rhythm, free-text, practical are **placeholders**

boxes.title: Asks the mentor
boxes.body: Question + lesson id + last score summary · canned lines when no server

boxes.title: Mentor proxy
boxes.body: `POST /api/v1/mentor/message` · signed-in user · persona + lesson from server catalogs · ≤ 2,000 chars · canned fallback

boxes.title: Claude — mentor reply
boxes.body: `claude-sonnet-4-6` default (`LLM_MODEL`) · 300 tokens · 15 s timeout · alt `gpt-4o-mini` · stub when no key

boxes.title: Messages API
boxes.body: `POST api.anthropic.com/v1/messages` (x-api-key) · or `POST api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions`

boxes.title: Mentor memory
boxes.body: Last 10 turns per mentor + learner in `mentorMemory.json`

boxes.title: Cost and prompt safety
boxes.body: 2M tokens/day global · 50k/user/day · 20 req/min · client can't change the persona

boxes.title: Upgrades
boxes.body: Pro unlocks L4+; paywall off during launch promo (first 200 users or 90 days)

boxes.title: Checkout and webhooks
boxes.body: `POST /api/v1/billing/checkout` · `POST /api/v1/billing/webhook/stripe` (signature + idempotency ledger) · `/iap/verify` **stub**

boxes.title: Payments
boxes.body: customers.create · checkout.sessions.create · webhooks.constructEvent · subscriptions.cancel

boxes.title: App Store / Play receipts
boxes.body: Receipt verification is a TODO; `subscriptions.json` + ledger on flat file

boxes.title: Paywall is client-side
boxes.body: Plan read from localStorage; server enforcement planned. Launch cap counts signed-in users only

boxes.title: Community and teaching
boxes.body: Recitals, profiles, assignments, creator portal, proctored exams, live lessons, compositions · song upload (visible)

boxes.title: Routes behind FEATURES flag
boxes.body: Registered only when enabled · admin-only: pass exam, publish lesson, review composition · owner-only profiles

boxes.title: Composition auto-review
boxes.body: Same provider as the mentor · rubric scores + strengths · `FEATURES=compositions`

boxes.title: Basic Pitch + Demucs
boxes.body: Song upload `POST /transcribe` · `POLYPHONIC_BACKEND`, `STEMS_BACKEND` (off)

boxes.title: Zoom · Resend · Stripe Connect
boxes.body: `POST zoom.us/oauth/token`, `api.zoom.us/v2/users/{id}/meetings` · `POST api.resend.com/emails` · accounts.create · yt-dlp off (`YT_DLP_ENABLED`)

boxes.title: Postgres · S3/R2 · Sentry · PostHog
boxes.body: `PERSISTENCE_DRIVER=postgres` (12 tables, dual-write) · `STORAGE_DRIVER=s3` · on when keys set

boxes.title: Server auth tests
boxes.body: 32 tests: spoofed ids, forged tokens, admin/owner checks, hidden routes 404, boot smoke test

steps.group: UC1 · Open and pick an instrument

items.text: The learner opens the web app, runs a short mic check (browser echo cancelling, noise suppression and auto-gain are switched off because they distort music), and picks an instrument. Eight hand-authored instruments are shown; 14 generated ones are hidden.
The app restores the learner's place from browser storage (user, progress, current instrument and lesson) and asks the server for the launch-promo status (`GET /api/v1/monetization/status`).
Sign-in is optional. When Supabase is configured the app signs in through Supabase Auth (email, magic link, Google or Apple); otherwise it uses an anonymous device id.
The lesson runner walks the first four of nine phases: what you're learning, the written lesson, demo clips at 50/75/100 % speed, and close-ups of each instrument control.
Lesson text, exercises (745) and drills are bundled into the app from the shared catalogs. Demo audio is requested from the server (`GET /api/v1/reference-audio/:lessonId`).
The server asks the audio engine to synthesize the demo (`POST /render`). It is a computer-generated tone, not a recorded musician — recorded demos are not integrated yet.
The learner plays the on-screen instrument to find the lesson's notes. The keyboard range follows the lesson, so left-hand and bass lessons are playable.
The app counts a hit on the exact note, or on the same note name when the on-screen instrument can't reach that octave; for drums any distinct pads count. Sound comes from Tone.js.
Piano, guitar and violin samples load from a public GitHub Pages CDN (tonejs-instruments). Self-hosted, licensed samples are planned.

The learner starts the exercise: the mic opens with a live level meter, a one-bar count-in clicks, then they play. The take ends automatically or when they tap Done. Offline mode saves the take on the device instead of grading it.
Audio is kept only from just before the downbeat, so warm-up notes never reach the grader, and is packed as a WAV file. The live pitch meter runs in the browser and is display-only.

The app sends the take, the target notes (stretched to the take's tempo), the rubric and the mode (notes, or onsets for claps, drums and tabla) to the audio engine (`POST /grade`, 30-second timeout). A health check drives the live / offline / demo status chip.

The engine finds the pitch frame by frame (pYIN), splits notes where they are re-struck, lines the take up with the target while allowing for a late start and a different tempo, and scores pitch in cents, rhythm and consistency. Tone and dynamics are reported as not graded.
No AI model is used by default. The CREPE neural pitch model can replace pYIN with `PITCH_BACKEND=crepe`. Offline takes are graded the same way when the device comes back online.
The learner sees the score, a plain list of what to fix, their take overlaid on the target, a short corrective drill, and the lesson's mastery quiz.
The lesson's own pass rules are applied on top of the rubric, then XP, hearts and completed lessons are updated in browser storage. A simulated (demo-mode) grade never changes progress.
The learner asks the mentor a question in the chat panel; the app sends the message with the lesson id and a summary of the last score.

The server checks the learner is signed in, limits them to 30 messages a minute, builds the mentor's persona and lesson context from its own catalogs (the client can't rewrite it), and caps the message at 2,000 characters.

Claude writes a 2–5 sentence reply in the mentor's voice with one concrete next step (`claude-sonnet-4-6` by default, 300-token cap). Without an API key a stub answers; if the call fails a canned line is used.
The call goes to Anthropic's Messages API (or OpenAI's chat API if that provider is configured). The last 10 turns are remembered per mentor and learner on the server.
Level 4 and above need the Pro plan; during the launch promo (first 200 users or 90 days) everything is unlocked.
The server starts a Stripe Checkout for the signed-in user and updates the subscription from Stripe's signed webhook, ignoring duplicates. App Store / Play receipt verification is a stub.
Stripe calls: create customer, create checkout session, verify webhook signature, cancel subscription.
Community recitals, profiles, teacher assignments, the creator portal, proctored exams, live 1:1 lessons and composition review are hidden until the core loop is proven. Song upload is visible.
Their server routes exist only when switched on with `FEATURES`. Passing an exam, publishing a creator lesson and reviewing a composition are admin-only; profiles and assignments are owner-only.
When compositions are switched on, uploaded pieces get an automatic first review from the same LLM provider, which a human reviewer can override.
Integrations used by these features: Zoom (meeting links for exams and lessons), Resend (emails), Stripe Connect (creator payouts). URL import with yt-dlp is off.

sections.title: Data and history calls
bullets: **Read on every visit:** browser localStorage — user, progress, XP, hearts, plan, launch status, current lesson (`client/src/atoms`).
**Written per take:** last grade and completed lessons to localStorage; offline takes (WAV + request) to IndexedDB `musicluv/offlineAttempts`.
**Server flat files** (`MUSICLUV_DATA_DIR`): progress, mentor memory (last 10 turns), subscriptions, Stripe ledgers, launch state, users, quests, community data. One server only; not backed up.
**Optional Postgres dual-write** (`PERSISTENCE_DRIVER=postgres`, 12 tables in `server/src/persistence/migrate.ts`): progress and attempts mirrored; flat file stays the source of truth.
**Not integrated:** server-side grade history (the `/api/v1/grade` proxy is unused by the app), recorded reference audio, cross-device sync, App Store / Play receipts.
